company.name: Noon Academy
company.shortDescription: Noon Academy is the leading edtech platform in the Middle East, having taught 12 million students.
company.description: Noon Academy is the leading edtech platform in the Middle East, having taught 12 million students. We have recently raised $41 million in Series B funding to expand our reach and impact in the region and beyond. We focus on making learning fun and engaging, both online, and in physical classrooms. Our ultimate goal is to provide access to the best teachers to every student even if that teacher is only available virtually. We believe we can do this if we blend AI, peer-to-peer learning, and a carefully designed physical space.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $40,783,719, or 65.38% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $43,290,645 to $278,781,625, a 6.44x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 91 (+4 over 90 days) and market heat at 67 (+6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
